tei:div.tei:p: &!"#$%& ༄༅)// ri dgon bkra shis chos gling gi phyag bzhes rgyun mkho'i chos spyod kyi rim pa phyogs gcig tu bkod pa rnam grol lam gyi shing rta bzhugs so//

bskal bzang rnam 'dren sgyu skar phreng dbus thugs bskyed rmad byung 'od dkar dbang po shākya'i tog /legs gsung bka' dang de'i dgongs 'grel nyon mongs gdung sel dam chos bdud rtsi'i mdzod chen po// rig grol 'phags pa'i dge 'dun sde ste rin chen rnam gsum grags pa'i ba dan gyis// byang chub bar du 'bral med rjes su bzung ste rnam grol 'bras bu mchis par mdzod// gzhi dbyings mi 'gyur ka dag spros bral chos sku'i lha lam yangs pa la// gzhi snang ma 'gags kun gsal khyab brdal gdangs gsal longs sku'i nyin mor byed// gzhi yi rang rtsal sna tshogs shar grol sprul sku'i 'od zer stong 'bar bas// gzhi grol ston mdzad rigs brgya'i khyab bdag drin chen bla mar gus pas 'dud// dri med mdangs ldan yan lag brgyad ldan chu gter klong*// skyon bral chu skyes ge sar 'dzum mdangs ngom pa las// rdzus skyes sku 'khrungs mtsho skyes rdo rje sprul pa'i sku// sangs rgyas gnyis pa'i zhabs rdul tshangs gnas rgyan du mchod// rgyal ba kun gyi gsung gi dbang phyug che// sor rtogs ye shes rang gzugs dpal chen po// dbang chen rta mchog rol pa'i dkyil 'khor gyis// byang chub bar du 'bral med rjes 'dzin mdzod// chos sku skye med spros bral kun bzang mo// longs sku 'gags med badz+ra wā ra hi// sprul sku rtsal snang dzña na sa ga ra// bde chen bskyed mdzad dhā ki'i tshogs la 'dud// rgyal ba'i spyan sngar rnam bzhi'i phrin las kyis// rgyal bstan srung bar zhal bzhes dam mnos pa'i// rdo rje'i bstan srung dam can rgya mtsho'i tshogs// rdo rje'i yal gam gnyan la dgongs shig kye// o rgyan chen po'i zab mo'i chos gter rgyud lung man ngag gdams pa'i mdzod// sgo 'phar yangs por gsar du 'byed pa'i phrin las snang ba'i mu khyud kyis// bsil ljongs bstan 'gro'i rgud pa'i snang ba pha mthar bskrad de rgyal ba'i bstan// pad+ma'i tshal chen kun tu rgyas byed gter chen chos kyi nyin byed 'dud// gang de'i zab gter smin grol bdud rtsi'i mal gro'i klung*// phyogs kyi pha mthar 'dren cing mi nub 'dzin 'chang spel// 'dzam gling rdo rje mthu stobs gling pa kun bzang nam mkha' rdo rje dang*// 'khrul zhig chen po rig 'dzin dbang rgyal kun bzang pad+ma rnam rgyal zhabs// rig 'dzin chen po zhi gnas rdo rje pad+ma bde byed rol pa dang*// me tog rgyal po sengha gu ru 'jigs med tshe dbang mchog grub zhabs// bo dhi'i mtshan sogs dngos dang brgyud pa'i drin can dpal ldan bla ma la// gus pas 'dud do byin rlabs dngos grub 'dod rgu'i gru char dbab tu gsol// gter chen gang de'i rnam 'phrul bstan 'gro'i dpal mgon tshar du dngar ba yi// mchog sprul pad+ma rab rgyas rtsal dang pad+ma bstan 'dzin dbang phyug zhabs// kun bzang pad+ma dgyes rdor zhabs dang pad+ma gsang sngags rdo rje'i mtshan// karma gsang sngags bstan 'dzin rdo rje karma yongs 'dus chos kyi nyi// gser ri'i grangs su rim par byon pa'i sprul brgyud dpal ldan bla ma la// gus pas 'dud do dge legs dpal yon me tog gru char bsnyil du gsol// zhes mchod par brjod pas mdun bsus te o rgyan sangs gnyis pa'i thugs sras/

dbang chen dngos sprul thabs kyi dpa' bo ar+ya sa le dang*/ gnubs ban nam mkha'i snying po/ pad+ma gsung gi bka' babs rig 'dzin rgyal ba mchog dbyangs bcas zung du 'jug pa'i rnam 'phrul/ gter chen chos kyi rgyal po o rgyan bsam gtan gling pa'am stag sham nus ldan rdo rje'i zab mo'i gter chos kyi ring lugs 'khrul med 'dzin pa'i stag sham chos bdag tu lung gis zin pa/ grub dbang ri pa bla rgan rje pad+ma bde byed rol pa'am karma grags pa bstan 'dzin rgya mtshos phyag btab gnang ba'i ri dgon bkra shis chos gling gi gtsos pa'i stag sham gyi dgon gnas ma lag dang bcas pa rnams kyi snga dgong zhal 'don chos spyod kyi rim pa rig 'dzin brgyud pa'i phyag bzhes gzhir bzhag thog /mkhas dang grub pa'i dbang phyug dam pa rnams kyi rdo rje'i gsung gal gnad che ba 'ga' zhig gis zur brgyan te deng dus dang 'tshams par sdebs pa la thog mar dkar chag ldeb/ 6 'phags pa bkra shis brgyad pa/ 1-4 rdo rje rnam par 'joms pa'i gzungs/ 5-12 chos spyod spyi 'gro/ 13-44 ston pa'i mdzad bcu/ 45-50 gnas brtan phyag mchod/ 51-60 byang chub sems dpa'i ltung bshags/ 61-68 'phags pa dkon mchog gsum rjes su dran pa'i mdo/ 69-74 tshig bdun gsol 'debs/ 75-78 stag sham bla brgyud gsol 'debs/ 79-84 gsol 'debs le'u bdun ma rten bskyed dang bcas pa/ 85-136 bsam pa lhun grub/ 137-152 bar chad lam sel/ 153-162 bsam pa myur 'grub/ 163-166 zhal chems gsol 'debs/ 167-168 gsol 'debs drug po/ 169-198 gter chen rnam thar gsol 'debs bsdus pa/ 199-202 stag sham thun bzhi'i gsol 'debs/ 203-216 ri bla pad+ma bde byed rol pa'i bla ma'i rnal 'byor/ 217-220 dus chen tshes bcu'i gsol 'debs/ 221-230 mtsho rgyal rnam thar gsol 'debs/ 231-246 dkon mchog spyi 'dus gter gzhung*/ 247-258 rta mgrin yi ge drug pa'i brgyud 'debs dang las byang*/
